title: fidelis: zero-LLM agent memory for Claude Code and AI agents
mechanism: Zero-LLM agent memory: deterministic rule/pattern-based extraction and storage of agent interaction history for Claude Code, avoiding LLM calls in the write path

expected_gain.rationale: chitta distillation is already native C++ with no LLM in the write path (--distill-interval 60, live), so the paper's core claim overlaps existing capability rather than adding gain

evidence.claim: Paper provides only a title, no abstract or methodology text was retrievable
Chitta's distillation pipeline runs as native C++ (field_distill.cpp) with no LLM call, per inventory
Chitta's default recall strategy (hybrid) is RRF over semantic/typed/spreading/session lanes, also non-LLM at query time
